notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «شعبة»; «ابن، بشار» is the second co-transmitter with its «و» dropped (rule 1)
«قالا حدثنا» joins branch two; the names from «الحكم» on are written once and belong to both branches (rule 3)
«محمد بن جعفر» is branch two's shaykh; it is not merged with «غندر» (rule 9)
«وقال ابن بشار» gives a wording variant only, left out (rule 4)
